name: System
description: Macro bot with an in-game menu: record and replay inputs frame by frame.

menu-key.name: Menu key
menu-key.description: Key that opens and closes the System menu.

hotkeys.name: F1-F5 hotkeys
hotkeys.description: F1 record, F2 replay, F3 stop, F4 save, F5 load (works inside a level).

tps.name: TPS
tps.description: Physics steps per second used when TPS is unlocked (also editable in the System menu).

tps-unlock.name: Unlock TPS
tps-unlock.description: Run the game with a custom fixed TPS. When off, TPS is only fixed (240) while recording/replaying.

fps.name: FPS
fps.description: FPS limit used when FPS is unlocked (also editable in the System menu).

fps-unlock.name: Unlock FPS
fps-unlock.description: Use the custom FPS limit instead of the game's own.

autosave.name: Auto-save recordings
autosave.description: Save a recording to the replay list automatically when you stop recording.
